title: Show the portal dashboard periods and the live metrics refusal

costar.context: Portal lists now load from object/get. The user said go, which continues the fixed screens. This server is already bootstrapped, so the screen in use is the dashboard.
costar.objective: Add the portal period control and the live metrics result from GET /api/token/metrics.
costar.style: One plan, then the adapter and the dashboard screen.
costar.audience: The maintainer and the next coding agent.
costar.response: The dashboard offers Last 24 hours, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, and Last 90 days. On this build the metrics token is refused and the screen says the server refused the live metrics stream.

concerns: GET /api/token/metrics is inside the non-enterprise branch and returns NotFound with details Enterprise feature. A 200 token would mean this build is the enterprise edition, and this slice must not invent metric numbers.
The period control does not change the token request. The portal uses the period on the metrics query, which this build refuses before that query.
401 means the management call did not accept the session. That is sign-in, not a metrics refusal.
A network failure is Failed to connect to live metrics. A 404 or 403 is The server refused the live metrics stream.
context: The dashboard cards already come from the schema overview. The portal also has four period presets and three live-metrics failure sentences. The token route is the gate in front of the event stream.
current_state: PortalView renders the six cards and no period control. Nothing calls /api/token/metrics. The home page and the Dashboard nav item both render that static view.
target_design: A route module calls the adapter. The adapter sends the session Authorization header to GET /api/token/metrics and classifies the status. The catalog draws the period buttons and the portal sentence. All nodes stays the only node choice because this response does not include a node list.
changes: Render the four period presets, All nodes, and the metrics status on the dashboard.
Use that dashboard for /portal and for /portal/CustomComponent/Dashboard.
boundaries: Do not open the event stream without a token.
Do not call a set method.
Do not build the bootstrap wizard or the Astro site in this slice.

verification.name: metrics-status-and-copy
verification.proves: 404 and 403 are the refusal, 401 is sign-in, and the dashboard view contains the four period labels plus both failure sentences. A dashboard that only shows the cards fails.

verification.name: ui-types
verification.proves: The dashboard route and the catalog view typecheck with the rest of the app.
